run_python_tests: run Python unit tests with regex filtering and JSON output for Buck test runner
collect_test_coverage: collect code coverage data for Python test modules using the coverage library
list_available_tests: list all available Python test cases matching a regex pattern without executing them
create_test_loader: create a RegexTestLoader to filter and load test cases by name pattern from modules
configure_test_logging: configure per-category log levels for Python test runs using the logger option
